question: India's first lithium refinery, which will process lithium ore to produce battery-grade material, will be set up in:
solution:
The correct answer is __Gujarat__

__
 
• Gujarat government has announced to set up India’s first Lithium refinery which will process Lithium ore to produce battery-grade material.
 
• Manikaran Power Limited, one of the country’s largest power trading and renewable energy company will be investing over Rs 1,000 crore to set up this refinery.
 
• The company are currently exploring a couple of places in Sanand and Dholera to set up this refinery.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Lithium is a rare element not usually found in India.
 
• The company will be importing Lithium ore from Australia and will be processing it in a refinery.
 
• In 2019, Manikaran Power had collaborated with Australian firm Neometals to tap the Mount Marion Lithium mine in Western Australia.
 
• TDS Lithium-Ion Battery Gujarat Private Ltd is India’s first Lithium-ion battery manufacturing plant in Gujarat which is being set up jointly between Toshiba Corporation, DENSO Corporation and Suzuki Motor Corporation.
 
• The foundation stone for the Rs 1135 crore plant was laid in September 2017 by Prime Minister Narendra Modi and his Japanese counterpart Shinzo Abe.
 
• The plant is expected to become operational by January or February 2021.
